label: Lucas et al. perceived automation experiment
design: 2 x 2 experiment varying automation framing and actual control method
population: adult participants in a virtual-human health-screening interview
setting: semi-structured interview with the visually constant Ellie virtual human
intervention: told that the interviewer was fully computer-controlled
comparator: told that the interviewer was tele-operated by a human
methods: crossed manipulation of framing with actual automatic-versus-tele-operated method
self-report, automated facial-expression analysis, and blind transcript ratings
